in_sanskrit.name: दुर्वास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Durvasa is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dur’ meaning difficult or hard and ‘vas’ meaning to please or satisfy. The name Durvasa signifies someone who is hard to please or someone who can inflict suffering and pain.

in_hindi.name: दुर्वास
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Durvasa in Hindi translates to 'one who is not easily satisfied'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dur’ meaning difficult or hard and ‘vas’ meaning to please or satisfy.

in_tamil.name: துர்வாஸ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Durvasa translates to 'one who takes a long time to arrive'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dur’ meaning difficult or hard and ‘vas’ meaning to come or arrive.

in_telugu.name: దుర్వాశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Durvasa translates to 'one who is difficult or hard to approach'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dur’ meaning difficult or hard and ‘vas’ meaning to approach or come near.

in_marathi.name: Durvasa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durvasa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Durvasa is the name of an angry god in Hindu mythology. He is known to have cursed various gods and sages due to his quick temperament. This name symbolizes strength, power, and the unpredictability of emotions.
